changelog: Security Hardening: Prevented Windows DLL & binary planting by enforcing strictly qualified installation directory lookups
Security Hardening: Eliminated command injection risks in URL handling with strict protocol whitelisting
Security Hardening: Integrated SHA-256 cryptographic checksum verification for all update packages
Encrypted DNS: Enabled DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) remote resolution to prevent DNS tampering and ISP sniffing
Leak Protection: Enforced IPv6 kernel-level blocking to prevent traffic leaks on dual-stack networks
Reliability: Implemented atomic state file persistence to protect against unexpected shutdown corruption
UX Improvements: Fixed window minimize and tray closing behaviors to ensure seamless background operation
